These are not temporary oversights waiting to be corrected — they are deliberate structural decisions built into conventional payment [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-payment-methods-filipino-digital-creators|COREMERCH guide to infrastructure]] designed for Western banking systems. It is [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/building-crypto-store-cloudflare-pages-step-step-deployment-23|building]] on infrastructure that does not have the problem in the first place. That means GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain payment verification. No platform can restrict access to a store that runs under your own accounts with no dependency on any payment processor.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Ebooks nigeria

The restrictions imposed by platforms like PayPal and Stripe are not just minor inconveniences; they fundamentally limit the ability for creators in Nigeria to sell ebooks and other digital products. When a country is excluded from these systems, it results in a lack of infrastructure that supports online commerce. This is where sovereign commerce infrastructure comes in, providing a base-layer solution that allows creators to process payments, store data, and deliver products without depending on external platforms. This architecture not only empowers creators but also ensures they have full ownership of their digital storefronts.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Sovereign commerce infrastructure operates through a combination of free and low-cost tools that work together to create a robust digital sales platform. For instance, using Cloudflare Pages for hosting allows creators to maintain a static site without incurring costs. Backend logic can be handled using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, providing flexibility and scalability. Products are stored in Supabase or Google Sheets, while file delivery is managed through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Payment processing is streamlined with NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies and charges only a 0.5% fee. This architecture ensures that the entire process is seamless, secure, and independent from any traditional payment systems.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions underserved by traditional payment platforms. Whether you are an author selling ebooks, a musician sharing beats, or an educator offering courses, this architecture provides the tools you need to succeed. By addressing the unique challenges faced in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Kenya, this solution allows creators to bypass the limitations of established financial systems. With full data ownership and no dependency on third-party platforms, creators can build sustainable revenue streams and maintain control over their digital businesses.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure eliminates dependency on restricted payment platforms.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The effectiveness of sovereign commerce infrastructure lies in its carefully chosen components. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serve as the front end for your online store, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle the necessary backend processes. Order storage can be easily managed through Supabase or Google Sheets, which provide a user-friendly way to keep track of sales and inventory. File delivery is made efficient with Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ensuring that customers receive their products instantly upon purchase. Finally, NOWPayments enables straightforward cryptocurrency transactions, providing flexibility and reliability without the constraints of traditional payment systems.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started, first choose a hosting solution like Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to manage order processing. Store your product data in Supabase or Google Sheets for easy access. For file delivery, utilize Google Drive to host your ebooks and other digital products. Finally, integrate NOWPayments to enable cryptocurrency payment processing, providing a seamless checkout experience for your customers. This step-by-step approach ensures that you can launch your online store quickly and effectively, without the need for traditional payment platforms.

If Stripe is not available in your country, you can sell digital products using sovereign commerce infrastructure. This approach leverages free tools and cryptocurrency payment systems to create an independent online store. By deploying a solution like the Edge Commerce Stack, you can launch your store within 48 hours, allowing you to reach customers without the limitations of traditional payment platforms.
You maintain full ownership of your digital products and customer data.

Your Deployment Checklist

Accept that no workaround inside conventional payment infrastructure is durable — platforms actively close gaps as they discover them. Create a NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as your starting point — these cover the widest range of buyers in restricted markets. Choose your stack: Stack 01 for a self-deployed free setup using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, Stack 02 for the Edge Stack deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours. Configure the NOWPayments webhook endpoint URL in your IPN settings pointing to your backend. Upload your product files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the full pipeline: webhook received, transaction verified on-chain, order logged, delivery email sent, download link working. Share your store URL only after the mainnet test passes cleanly.
